nights.title: Doja Cat - Tour Ma Vie World Tour
nights.name: Doja Cat
nights.extract: Amala Ratna Zandile Dlamini, known professionally as Doja Cat, is an American rapper and singer-songwriter. Regarded as the "Queen of Pop-Rap", she is known for her musical versatility, live performance skills and humorous internet presence. Billboard named her "one of the world's biggest pop stars" and "one of the defining pop stars of this era", and Time listed her as one of the world's most influential people in 2023.

nights.title: Adelitas Way
nights.name: Adelitas Way
nights.extract: Adelitas Way is an American rock band formed in Las Vegas in 2006. The band's debut single "Invincible" broke them into the mainstream scene after the song made numerous television appearances in commercials and live sporting events. The band has toured with notable acts such as Guns N' Roses, Creed, Papa Roach, Godsmack, Theory of a Deadman, Seether, Three Days Grace, Breaking Benjamin, Deftones, Puddle of Mudd, Sick Puppies, Shinedown, Staind, Alter Bridge, Skillet, Halestorm, Thousand Foot Krutch, Red and others.

nights.title: Stephen Day
nights.name: Stephen Day
nights.extract:
Stephen Day is an American singer-songwriter based in Nashville, Tennessee. Day released his debut extended play Undergrad Romance and The Moses In Me in April 2016 during his sophomore year of college. Day has released four full-length studio albums, Guess I'm Grown Now — and its acoustic version, The Shapes I'm In, Gold Mine, and Stephen Day. 
Day has been signed to Riser House Records, based in Nashville, since October 2024.

nights.title: Slow Pulp
nights.name: Slow Pulp
nights.extract: Slow Pulp is an American indie rock band from Madison, Wisconsin, currently based in Chicago, Illinois. Formed in 2015, the band has held the same line-up since 2017: Emily Massey on lead vocals and rhythm guitar, Alex Leeds on bass and backing vocals, Teddy Matthews on drums and percussion, and Henry Stoehr on lead guitar. The band have released three studio albums to date: Moveys (2020), Yard (2023), and Melodie (2026).

nights.title: Dinosaur Jr. - Fall Tour 2026 with special guest Stef Chura
nights.name: Dinosaur Jr.
nights.extract: Dinosaur Jr. is an American rock band formed in Amherst, Massachusetts, in 1984. The band was founded by J Mascis, Lou Barlow, and Murph (drums). After three albums on independent labels, the band earned a reputation as one of the formative influences on American alternative rock. Creative tension led to Mascis firing Barlow, who later formed Sebadoh and Folk Implosion. His replacement, Mike Johnson, came aboard for three major-label albums. Murph eventually quit, with Mascis taking over drums on the band's albums before the group disbanded in 1997. The original lineup reformed in 2005, releasing six albums thereafter.

nights.title: Turnover - Down On Earth Tour
nights.name: Turnover
nights.extract: Turnover is an American rock band from Virginia Beach, Virginia. The band were formed in 2009 by brothers Austin and Casey (drums) Getz alongside longtime friend Danny Dempsey (bass); the three have gone on to oversee every iteration of the band to date. The three are currently joined in the band by lead guitarist Nick Rayfield, who began touring with the band in 2017 and was later officially inducted as a full-time member in 2022. Turnover have released six studio albums and four EPs across their career. Their most recent album, Down on Earth, was released on May 29th 2026.

nights.title: Steve Lacy: Oh yeah? Tour
nights.name: Steve Lacy
nights.extract: Steve Thomas Lacy-Moya is an American singer-songwriter, guitarist and record producer. He gained recognition as the guitarist of the alternative R&B band the Internet, which he joined in 2015. His self-produced debut EP, Steve Lacy's Demo (2017), was met with critical praise and became a sleeper hit. Lacy then guest performed alongside Frank Ocean on Tyler, the Creator's 2017 single "911 / Mr. Lonely", which received double platinum certification by the Recording Industry Association of America (RIAA). That year, he also co-wrote songs for artists including Solange Knowles, and Kendrick Lamar on his song "Pride".

nights.title: MANÁ: VIVIR SIN AIRE TOUR
nights.name: Maná
nights.extract: Maná is a Mexican pop rock band formed in 1981. Originally called Sombrero Verde, the current lineup of members is vocalist-guitarist Fher Olvera, drummer Alex González, guitarist Sergio Vallín and bassist Juan Calleros. The band is one of the best-selling Latin Mexican music artists and the most successful Latin American band of all time with over 45 million records sold worldwide. Maná has earned four Grammy Awards, eight Latin Grammy Awards, five MTV Video Music Awards Latin America, six Premios Juventud awards, 19 Billboard Latin Music Awards and 15 Premios Lo Nuestro awards.

nights.title: Greg Freeman
nights.name: Greg Freeman
nights.extract: Greg Freeman is an American alternative country musician based in Burlington, Vermont. Freeman was raised in Bethesda, Maryland. Freeman released his debut studio album in 2022 titled I Looked Out, through the record label Bud Tapes. After the album slowly gained attention, it was reissued in 2024 through Transgressive Records imprint Canvasback Music. Freeman announced his second full-length album in April 2025 titled Burnover. The album was released on August 22, 2025. Freeman's third full length album, All Set The Bone, was released on October 2, 2026

nights.name: Tiny Habits
